spec.description:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Den is an acoustic workstation screen designed to
provide a semi-enclosed, focused sanctuary within busy open-plan offices.
Featuring an integrated side return wing, Den creates defined personal territory
while absorbing direct speech and conversational distractions (0.75 Sabins per
unit). Fixed non-destructively to desktops via Vicinity Clamps, it is formed
from 100% polyester fibre with an 80% recycled PET core and achieves Group 1
fire compliance.

install:
Unpack Vicinity Den panels and inspect screen
components

Slide Vicinity Workstation Clamps into pre-cut slots on the screen
base

Position screen and side return wing assembly onto desk corner
perimeter

Tighten clamp bolts from underside of desktop using an Allen key
until firmly locked

Confirm screen is plumb and securely seated along both
back and side edges
selection_checklist:
Confirm desk size (Den 1600
for 1600mm desks or Den 1800 for 1800mm desks)

Verify desk edge overhang and
clearance for clamp brackets

Choose left-hand or right-hand side return
orientation if applicable
Select colour from the Autex Cube palette
Confirm pack quantity requirement (packs of 4 screens, 2 pieces per screen)
limitations: Indoor use only; avoid direct water exposure

Desk top must allow clamp
fixing without under-frame interference

Ensure screen return wings do not
obstruct user access or cable ports

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Den is a
semi-enclosed acoustic desk screen featuring an integrated side return wing to
create a personal focus shelter on 1600mm or 1800mm workstations. Crafted
from 12mm Cube polyester felt with an 80% recycled PET core, it absorbs 0.75
